Hi Steven,

Thanks for the delivery screenshot, that helps. Your box did arrive at our Chattanooga, TN warehouse this morning, 9:23am, under return reference Shop····. It has not been checked in by the warehouse team yet, that is the step where they log it and mark it received, and it usually follows within a day or two of delivery. I will write to you the day it is logged, you do not need to chase it.

On the Bitfortun BS-4 (18 TH/s), your choice is recorded and the unit is set aside for you. The B.4 is $599.99 and the credit on your NerdOctaxe is $399.99, so $200.00 is the difference. I cannot raise the payment link myself, so a colleague is picking that up today and it comes to this email address, on the same card you used, nothing for you to enter in a reply. Once that is settled and the return is checked in, the BS-4 is released to you. It ships from the manufacturer by October 31, and yes, it comes with the US AC cord and the Mean Well power supply.

So, two things left: the check-in and the $200 link. Both are moving today and I will keep you posted on each.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Steven L.

Hi Steven,

Good news on the return. Your NerdOctaxe was checked in at our Chattanooga warehouse on October 29 and the return Shop···· is closed on our side. The unit is with us, so nothing more is needed from you on that half.

That leaves the payment. The $200.00 difference between your $399.99 credit and the Bitfortun BS-4 at $599.99 still needs a secure link, and that is not something I can raise myself. It is in front of the team now with your order and the amount, and a colleague is picking it up today. It comes to this address and runs on the card you used originally, so please don't send any card details in a reply.

One thing I want to be straight with you about, because I quoted you a date yesterday. The B.4 now reads as shipping from the manufacturer by November 30, not the end of October. It still comes with the US cord and the Mean Well supply. If that wait is too long for you, say the word and I will put together what we have on the shelf in your price range so you can compare before you pay anything.

I will write again as soon as the link is out.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Done and paid for …
Thanks so much…

Looking forward to receiving it…

Any Idea how long it will take to get here?

Hi Steven,

Your $200.00 landed, thank you. It is showing as paid against your replacement order Shop····, one Bitfortun BS-4 (18 TH/s), and there is nothing further owed on it. Your NerdOctaxe return is closed out, so both halves of this are now done on paper.

On timing, I will give you the honest version rather than an optimistic one. The B.4 is a pre-order unit and it ships from the manufacturer by November 30. Yours is paid and in the queue, and because it goes out direct from the manufacturer rather than through Chattanooga first, it saves the leg to our warehouse. Once it leaves, it is normal parcel transit to (address hidden), and the tracking number emails to you automatically the moment the label is created. Nothing else is needed from you between now and then.

If anything moves earlier, you will hear it from me. And if you have not had tracking by December 1, reply here and I will chase it myself.

It comes with the US cord and the Mean Well LRS-350 in the box, as agreed.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
